clusters.objective: Maintain the home in a secured state whenever it is unoccupied by arming intrusion protection and closing shutters/windows.
clusters.lifecycle: recurring event_conditioned episodes triggered by household absence
clusters.meaningful_failure: security_failure (unoccupied home left unalarmed with openings unsecured)
clusters.authorized_action_scope: explicit: activate/arm alarm system, close shutters and windows
clusters.rationale: Two independent demand owners (user-22, user-31) converge on the same maintained outcome with both coders agreeing on household beneficiary, security_failure meaning, automation delegation, and explicit scope. Falls short of the candidate path (needs >=3 owners in one study cluster) and no unit is strongly_implies/entails by both coders, so below admission thresholds locally; retained for cross-packet convergence check.
clusters.boundary_notes: Not merged with evening entry lighting (u13_r078), alarm-clock escalation (u31_r182, wake-up outcome), or pet-escape notification (practicaltap_p2, care/containment outcome). Both source rules are hypothetical and not deployed.
clusters.coding_disagreements: None material; luna and kimi ratings coincide on all fields; both rate standing_responsibility_support=compatible_only.
